title: The Monkey Who Stole The Phone
custom_script:
# Scene: jungle
Teddy: {yay} Look, Peddy! Perfect *selfie* spot! {phone} [happy, wave, excited]
Monkey: {giggle} Ooh, shiny *phone*! {walk-to} [happy, point]
Peddy: {gasp} Teddy, the monkey took your phone! [surprised, point, shout]
Teddy: {aah} Come back, you *thief*! {chase} [angry, point, shout, footsteps]
Monkey: {climb} Catch me if you can! {laugh} [happy, wave, laugh]
# Scene: jungle
Peddy: {hmm} Wait… he is taking *selfies*! [suspicious, think, whisper]
Monkey: {wow} I look *beautiful*! [happy, wave, excited]
Teddy: {facepalm} He has more *likes* than me. [sad, shrug, fail]
